findings.finding: Expired tracked PID prevented admission of a genuinely new descendant generation. Current loop re-admits only on live owned ancestry/original live leader group evidence and records old/new generations.

Initial v2 ignored a first-seen same-group survivor after the original leader exited. Current tracker raises uncertainty and retains the owned lease unless that generation has independently proven live owned ancestry.
Initial process-table validation rejected unrelated PID/PGID0 system entries. Current global inventory allows zero; owned leader/admission remains positive.

lifecycle_review.serial_children: 15 direct command/model/verifier processes, plus synchronous SFT workflow descendants. New sessions retain parent ancestry; observed reparented descendants stay tracked by birth.
lifecycle_review.completion: Require exact reviewed runner operational status completed_pending_quality_audit, exact plan/payload/numerical environment, exit0, absent error, input hashes unchanged, and no live or ambiguous tracked survivors. This does not certify model quality.
lifecycle_review.failure: Outer wrapper never signals any process and retains its own lease for explicit recovery on failure or uncertain cleanup. Inner reviewed runner retains its separate authorized child-cleanup behavior.

remaining_execution_gates: Fresh completed checkpoint full-payload receipt and immutable source manifest, exact model/config binding, newly prepared plan, and concrete request independently reviewed before launch.

Pin absolute planned Python executable/resolved target, run_m5_plan, helper, plan, runtime snapshot and completed payload receipt/source manifest in the request; do not pin legitimate mutable outputs.
Set only reviewed MLX_ENABLE_TF32=0 mode for the inner runner; use fresh prefix cache, baseline, logs and receipts. No automatic retries/resume.
Completion criteria must bind exact plan, payload receipt, expected status and quality_certified=false; verified_only or exit0 alone cannot release a model campaign lease.
qualification_limits: CPU source review and synthetic process-table/temporary-file tests only; no actual long campaign or remote mutation-lock stress test performed.

Cooperative shared lock cannot exclude software ignoring it. ps birth timestamps have limited resolution and polling cannot prove absence of a completely unsampled daemonized/reparented child; reviewed commands must synchronously wait for children and not detach background work.
Quiescent trusted input files remain required; this is not containment against hostile concurrent writers or OS-level process attestation.

Original single-process control receipts remain separate and unchanged. Final numerical quality, prior/final checkpoint selection, generated-code results and scientific claims require their own audits.
